title: Critical user journey
description: One CUJ entry of specs/<epic>/cuj.md, normalized from its '## CUJ-n · title' heading and '- **Field:** value' bullets (CONTRACTS.md, Normalization).

actor.description: Who or what system takes the journey. Free text; personas carries the trace link.

personas.description: Personas this journey serves ('- **Personas:** PER-1'). Required by the trace check once docs/product exists.

user_facing.description: '- **User-facing:** yes|no'. A user-facing journey needs a UX flow before readiness.

trigger.description: Maps to an EARS event-driven criterion.

success.description: The observable outcome. Maps to a state-driven or ubiquitous criterion.

unwanted.description: What must not happen. Maps to an unwanted-behaviour criterion.

extra.description: '**Field:**' bullets the parser does not map, keyed by label.
